changes: Add gratis donations for repositories without a Tokate policy using the existing donation loop and harness runners.
Read repository guidance and bounded donor prompts before confirmation, and record the prompt hash.
Save authenticated open PR snapshots and instruct agents to drop tasks that existing PRs cover.
Select unassigned and unlocked open issues without a linked open PR when no guidance is found.
Stop refused tasks without publication and report empty or findings-only outcomes as skipped or submitted.
Publish donor fork PRs with Tokate attribution, unapproved task receipts and no repository verification commands.
Publish validated findings to General Discussions when the agent follows guidance that explicitly requests them.
Keep PRs as drafts unless the agent follows guidance that authorizes ready PRs.
